text: Dear students, Welcome to GITsmeasures In today's video I am going to explain OLTP that is Online Transaction Processing See, you can understand from the name that we are performing transactions online Like as an example if you want to purchase a product on Amazon then what you do? You open Amazon's website or mobile application in that you search a particular product, after searching you will get many items in it You select a particular product you put it in the cart, you make the payment shipment will be generated, it will come to you in 2-4 days The whole system that is made that is actually the OLTP system You can take any other example Let's suppose, take the example of banking You are using Paytm, SBI So what are you doing online? You are performing a transaction You are performing some task, you are making a payment from here to there, that is what OLTP, Online Transaction Processing Or you take an example Let's say, the example of healthcare, telecommunication education Like you are paying your fees Let's say, you have a college or university fee If you are paying it online That is also what? OLTP, Online Transaction Processing Now the interesting thing in this is what components are getting involved in this See for yourself First of all, what is happening? User is getting involved in this. What is the user doing? He is opening some desktop application or mobile application and then in a similar way, user interface is done Through user interface, he is selecting those particular things If I want to book a hotel I will go to MMT or Goibibo and check the hotel If I want to purchase a product I will go to Amazon and purchase it So that means, on the basis of UI I am searching the first item and then finally I put it in the cart Now the application you are using, whether it is a desktop or mobile, it will be somewhere on some server and that is your application server So this application server may be you have kept it on-premises Means you have installed a server in your company The application is kept inside it or cloud-based which is used a lot Like Google App Engine, AWS services are used So all of these can be cloud-based So you have kept the application on it and what is in the backend? Database You are opening Amazon and searching some item How is the search going on? First they must have put something on the backend then only you can see That is what a database is So remember these three main components OLTP's database application and user interface and on the basis of this a transaction is performed Database which is on the backend like MySQL or Oracle or SQL Server There are many different softwares of yours through which the database is managed Application server as I told you earlier It can be on-premises or you have taken cloud services through which your application and user interface is your frontend in a way which is used by HTML, CSS or multiple techniques is made So somewhere this whole system is made so that user can easily perform transactions and when user performs a transaction then it creates a data and it is very important to save that data Why?
